result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by giving Licensee a 30-day written-notice convenience right, no termination fee, and a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, while adding no Licensor convenience right during the committed term. However, it goes beyond the playbook by permitting termination “in whole or in part” and broadly eliminating any payment obligation for periods after termination. Coupled with the overriding language, those additions could affect unrelated payment, usage, wind-down, or surviving obligations. The clause is generally clear but should be narrowed to termination of the Agreement and refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period.
